posts.trend: IBM India leases 2.83 lakh sq ft of office space in Bengaluru for ₹343 crore over 10 years
posts.context: Employees are dragged back to offices for collaboration that happens on screen anyway.
posts.angle: Hundreds of crores spent on floor space just so you can sit under fluorescent lights and join a call with London.
slides: ₹343 crore to recreate your living room in Outer Ring Road.

2.8 lakh square feet of glass.
Four biometric scanners.
One coffee machine out of milk.
Six people sitting together in complete silence.
The London team is still on mute.
posts.caption: Somebody on your team has been in the phone booth since 10 AM.
posts.rank_verdict: Outer Ring Road in the hook load-bears slightly too much local trivia before the joke lands.
